title: Mini Butter Cookies
creator: Julies food (@juliesfood2)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a baking sheet with a silicone mat or parchment paper.
In a large bowl, melt the butter.
Add the egg to the melted butter and stir to combine.
Pour in the yellow cake mix and stir until a thick dough forms.
Roll the dough into small teaspoon-sized balls (about 1 inch diameter for mini size).
Place the balls on the prepared baking sheet, spaced about 1 inch apart.
Bake for 8-10 minutes until set but not browned on top.
Let cool on the pan for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack.
